pre_proposal.title: Barangay Health Center Patient Records and Appointment System
pre_proposal.main_topic: Patient records and appointment scheduling for a barangay health center
pre_proposal.problem_statement: The health center keeps patient records on paper, so records are lost and patients wait a long time to be seen.
pre_proposal.proposed_solution: A system where staff record patient visits and patients book an appointment ahead of time.
pre_proposal.scope: One barangay health center, its staff and its patients.

other.title: Patient Information and Appointment Scheduling System for a Rural Health Unit
other.abstract: This study developed a system that stores the patient records of a rural health unit and lets patients schedule their consultations in advance, replacing the paper logbook.

other.title: Medicine Inventory Monitoring System for a Rural Health Unit
other.abstract: This study developed a system that tracks the stock and expiry dates of medicines in a rural health unit and warns the staff when a medicine is running low.
